title: POST /auth/login returns 201 instead of documented 200 on success
description: When a user logs in successfully, the system replies with a slightly different success code than the documentation says ("created" instead of plain "OK"). Login still works, so users won't notice, but apps that check for the exact documented code may wrongly treat a good login as a failure.
steps: Send POST https://fakestoreapi.com/auth/login with the demo credentials from the Fake Store docs
